notes: Auto-scroll no longer sits still. Only your own touch, wheel or key holds your place now; the sheet movement itself - its glide and its scroll-back - used to re-arm that hold, which is why it looked dead on some songs.
The highlight works on a song whose length the player has not published yet: the saved length is used, so a plain-lyrics sheet lights up and scrolls instead of doing nothing.
A timing measured from the audio is saved onto the song now. It was written to a settings row that carries no words, so the next launch measured the same song again from scratch.
A measurement that failed is retried instead of being remembered as done, so one file that could not be decoded no longer leaves a song without timings for the whole session.

New releases come back to the Home bubble, its count and Discover: the shared list read the pinned releases from outside the scope that owns them, so it quietly returned nothing and those rows were never painted.
Tapping an upcoming drop opens its page every time, and with a Gemini key connected the assistant answers your question with it instead of from the built-in notes.
